clusters.title: Bug Fixes, Compatibility Updates, and Feature Extensions
clusters.summary: Users want various bugs fixed including audio truncation during training, incomplete audio at low speech speeds, ONNX export issues with PyTorch 2.6, and crashes on RTX 50-series GPUs. Additionally, users request new features like native Spanish phonetic support, a plugin system for external tool integration, and documentation improvements for fine-tuning capabilities. These issues span both critical bug fixes and feature enhancements to improve the project's robustness and usability.
clusters.representative_need: Add native Spanish phonetic support to GPT-SoVITS with proper handling of RR, Ñ, silent H, accentuation, CH, LL, and intervocalic D
sample_titles: Add native Spanish phonetic support to GPT-SoVITS with proper handling of RR, Ñ, silent H, accentuation, CH, LL, and intervocalic D
Add skill/plugin system for integrating GPT-SoVITS models with external tools like openclaw
Document fine-tuning capabilities for custom tokens/tone control, clarify LoRA/adapter support, and provide guidance on multi-speaker fine-tuning strategies
